integrity: The argument is analytical. A standalone exact-rational and numerical finite-state verifier checks its identities but cannot certify the infinite theorem. Historical priority remains provisional and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Annealed expectations, not samplewise stochastic ordering; stationary retain-or-refresh kernel only. For 0<q<1 the closed-interval power-sum result requires an integrability condition, and finite expected Shannon entropy requires a log moment. No expected Rényi entropy or full species-count distribution ordering is claimed.
title: Strict persistence ordering of annealed diversity in stationary Markov stick breaking
